source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 1 (i)-(ix): maximum and minimum values of a + b sin/cos and of their reciprocals. Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(3 - \sin 3x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal sine ki had (boundary) par hai: \(\sin 3x\) sirf \(-1\) se \(1\) tak hi ja sakta hai, is se bahar kabhi nahi.
Humein poori expression \(3 - \sin 3x\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \sin 3x \le 1\) se shuru kar ke, qadam ba qadam wohi kaam karenge jo expression mein ho raha hai: pehle minus, phir 3 jama. Har qadam par inequality ko sambhal kar rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = 3 - \sin 3x\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: Har angle ke liye \(-1 \le \sin\theta \le 1\). Phir inequality ke saath bilkul wohi operations karenge jo expression \(\sin 3x\) ke saath karti hai: pehle \(-1\) se multiply, phir 3 jama.

Sine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \sin 3x \le 1\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ka sine hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, chahe angle \(x\) ho, \(3x\) ho ya \(5x + \pi\). Andar ka number (jaise 3) sirf yeh badalta hai ke wave kitni jaldi repeat hogi (period), wave ki unchai nahi badalti. Yahi poore sawal ki bunyaad hai.

\(-1\) se multiply karein
\[1 \ge -\sin 3x \ge -1\]
Kyun: Inequality ko negative number se multiply karein to \(\le\) ka nishan ulta ho jata hai. Misaal: \(2 < 5\) hai, lekin \(-2 > -5\). Is liye jo pehle sab se chhota tha woh ab sab se bara ban jata hai.

Har hisse mein 3 jama karein
\[4 \ge 3 - \sin 3x \ge 2\]
Kyun: Inequality ke teeno hisson mein ek hi number jama karne se nishan nahi badalte, bas saari values 3 upar khisak jati hain. Ab beech mein bilkul hamari expression \(3 - \sin 3x\) aa gayi, aur dono kinaron par us ki had likhi hai.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum 4 tab milta hai jab \(\sin 3x = -1\) ho, maslan \(3x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Minimum 2 tab jab \(\sin 3x = 1\), maslan \(3x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{6}\).
Kyun: Minus sign ki wajah se ulta hisaab hai: \(\sin 3x\) jitna chhota, expression utni bari.
Dhyan dein: Bahut se students yahan maximum ke liye \(\sin 3x = 1\) rakh dete hain; minus ko hamesha dekhein.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{2}: \; 3 - \sin\tfrac{3\pi}{2} = 3 + 1 = 4\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{6}: \; 3 - \sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 3 - 1 = 2\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(3 + \sin 2x\)
blocks.explanation:
Part (i) jaisa hi sawal hai, farq sirf itna ke yahan sine jama ho raha hai, minus nahi.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \sin 2x \le 1\) likh kar teeno hisson mein 3 jama kar dena. Yahan koi negative multiply nahi, is liye nishan bhi nahi palatne.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = 3 + \sin 2x\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: \(-1 \le \sin 2x \le 1\) likhein aur har hisse mein 3 jama karein. Expression mein sine ke saath sirf "+3" ho raha hai, is liye inequality ke saath bhi sirf yahi karna hai.

Sine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \sin 2x \le 1\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ka sine hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, chahe angle \(x\) ho, \(3x\) ho ya \(5x + \pi\). Andar ka number (jaise 3) sirf yeh badalta hai ke wave kitni jaldi repeat hogi (period), wave ki unchai nahi badalti. Yahi poore sawal ki bunyaad hai.

Har hisse mein 3 jama karein
\[2 \le 3 + \sin 2x \le 4\]
Kyun: 3 jama karne se poori range 3 upar chali jati hai: \(-1\) ban gaya 2 aur \(1\) ban gaya 4. Nishan wohi rehte hain kyunke jama karna inequality ko ulta nahi karta.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum 4 jab \(\sin 2x = 1\), maslan \(2x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\).
Minimum 2 jab \(\sin 2x = -1\), maslan \(2x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{3\pi}{4}\).
Kyun: Yahan plus sign hai, is liye sine bara to expression bari; seedha hisaab.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{4}: \; 3 + \sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 4\]
\[x = \tfrac{3\pi}{4}: \; 3 + \sin\tfrac{3\pi}{2} = 2\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(\frac{1}{2} + \sin(5x + \pi)\)
blocks.explanation:
Angle ab \(5x + \pi\) hai, jo dekhne mein mushkil lagta hai, lekin sine chahe kisi bhi angle ka ho, \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke beech hi rehta hai.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \sin(5x + \pi) \le 1\) likh kar teeno hisson mein \(\frac{1}{2}\) jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \frac{1}{2} + \sin(5x + \pi)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: \(5x + \pi\) ko ek hi angle \(\theta\) samjhein. Phir \(-1 \le \sin\theta \le 1\) aur us mein \(\frac{1}{2}\) jama. Angle ke andar \(+\pi\) sirf wave ko aadha chakkar khiskata hai, unchai nahi badalta.

Sine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \sin(5x + \pi) \le 1\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ka sine hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, chahe angle \(x\) ho, \(3x\) ho ya \(5x + \pi\). Andar ka number (jaise 3) sirf yeh badalta hai ke wave kitni jaldi repeat hogi (period), wave ki unchai nahi badalti. Yahi poore sawal ki bunyaad hai. Waise \(\sin(5x + \pi) = -\sin 5x\) bhi hai, aur \(-\sin 5x\) ki range bhi wohi \(-1\) se \(1\) hai.

Har hisse mein \(\frac{1}{2}\) jama karein
\[-\tfrac{1}{2} \le \tfrac{1}{2} + \sin(5x + \pi) \le \tfrac{3}{2}\]
Kyun: \(-1 + \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{1}{2}\) aur \(1 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2}\). Jama karne se nishan nahi badalte. Dhyan dein ke minimum negative aaya hai, \(-\frac{1}{2}\); is mein koi ghalti nahi, function negative ho sakta hai.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum \(\frac{3}{2}\) jab \(5x + \pi = \frac{5\pi}{2}\) (yahan sine 1 hai), yani \(5x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), \(x = \frac{3\pi}{10}\).
Minimum \(-\frac{1}{2}\) jab \(5x + \pi = \frac{3\pi}{2}\) (yahan sine \(-1\) hai), yani \(5x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(x = \frac{\pi}{10}\).
Kyun: \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\) aur \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ka sine ek hi hai (poora chakkar \(2\pi\) ka farq), lekin \(x\) positive rakhne ke liye \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\) liya.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{3\pi}{10}: \; \tfrac{1}{2} + \sin\tfrac{5\pi}{2} = \tfrac{3}{2}\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{10}: \; \tfrac{1}{2} + \sin\tfrac{3\pi}{2} = -\tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(\frac{3}{2} + \cos\left(x - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\)
blocks.explanation:
Cosine hai jis ka angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) khiska hua hai, aur saath ek constant jama hai.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \cos(x - \frac{\pi}{4}) \le 1\) likh kar teeno hisson mein \(\frac{3}{2}\) jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \frac{3}{2} + \cos\left(x - \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: \(\theta = x - \frac{\pi}{4}\) maan kar \(-1 \le \cos\theta \le 1\) lagayein, phir \(\frac{3}{2}\) jama karein. Phase shift (angle ka khiskna) maximum aur minimum ki value par asar nahi dalta, sirf yeh badalta hai ke woh kis \(x\) par aate hain.

Cosine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \cos\left(x - \tfrac{\pi}{4}\right) \le 1\]
Kyun: Cosine bhi sine ki tarah hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, angle chahe kuch bhi ho. Andar wala angle sirf graph ko aage peeche ya tez/aahista karta hai; upar neeche ki had wohi \(-1\) aur \(1\) rehti hai.

Har hisse mein \(\frac{3}{2}\) jama karein
\[\tfrac{1}{2} \le \tfrac{3}{2} + \cos\left(x - \tfrac{\pi}{4}\right)\]
\[\le \tfrac{5}{2}\]
Kyun: \(-1 + \frac{3}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\) aur \(1 + \frac{3}{2} = \frac{5}{2}\). Inequality lambi thi is liye do lines mein likhi; matlab ek hi hai: expression \(\frac{1}{2}\) aur \(\frac{5}{2}\) ke darmiyan hai.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum \(\frac{5}{2}\) jab \(\cos(x - \frac{\pi}{4}) = 1\), yani \(x - \frac{\pi}{4} = 0\), \(x = \frac{\pi}{4}\).
Minimum \(\frac{1}{2}\) jab \(\cos(x - \frac{\pi}{4}) = -1\), yani \(x - \frac{\pi}{4} = \pi\), \(x = \frac{5\pi}{4}\).
Kyun: \(\cos 0 = 1\) aur \(\cos\pi = -1\); yeh do angles yaad rakhein, cosine ke max/min yahin hote hain.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{4}: \; \tfrac{3}{2} + \cos 0 = \tfrac{5}{2}\]
\[x = \tfrac{5\pi}{4}: \; \tfrac{3}{2} + \cos\pi = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(1 - 3\cos 2x\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan cosine ko \(-3\) se multiply kiya gaya hai aur phir 1 jama hua hai.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: \(-1 \le \cos 2x \le 1\) ko \(-3\) se multiply karna (nishan palat jayenge), phir 1 jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = 1 - 3\cos 2x\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: \(-1 \le \cos 2x \le 1\) se shuru; \(-3\) se multiply (negative hai, is liye nishan ulte), phir 1 jama. Multiply ki wajah se range 3 guna chaudi ho jati hai: ise amplitude kehte hain, yahan amplitude 3 hai.

Cosine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \cos 2x \le 1\]
Kyun: Cosine bhi sine ki tarah hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, angle chahe kuch bhi ho. Andar wala angle sirf graph ko aage peeche ya tez/aahista karta hai; upar neeche ki had wohi \(-1\) aur \(1\) rehti hai.

\(-3\) se multiply karein
\[3 \ge -3\cos 2x \ge -3\]
Kyun: Inequality ko negative number se multiply karein to \(\le\) ka nishan ulta ho jata hai. Misaal: \(2 < 5\) hai, lekin \(-2 > -5\). Is liye jo pehle sab se chhota tha woh ab sab se bara ban jata hai. Yahan \(-1 \times -3 = 3\) aur \(1 \times -3 = -3\).

Har hisse mein 1 jama karein
\[4 \ge 1 - 3\cos 2x \ge -2\]
Kyun: \(3 + 1 = 4\) aur \(-3 + 1 = -2\). Ab beech mein bilkul \(1 - 3\cos 2x\) hai. Shortcut: \(a + b\cos\theta\) ka maximum \(a + |b|\) aur minimum \(a - |b|\), yani \(1 + 3 = 4\) aur \(1 - 3 = -2\).

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum 4 jab \(\cos 2x = -1\), maslan \(2x = \pi\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Minimum \(-2\) jab \(\cos 2x = 1\), maslan \(x = 0\).
Kyun: \(\cos 2x\) ke saath \(-3\) hai, is liye cosine sab se chhota (\(-1\)) ho to expression sab se bari.
Dhyan dein: "\(-3\cos 2x\) ka maximum \(-3\)" sochna ghalat hai; negative coefficient hamesha hisaab ulta karta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{2}: \; 1 - 3\cos\pi = 1 + 3 = 4\]
\[x = 0: \; 1 - 3\cos 0 = 1 - 3 = -2\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(1 + 2\sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\)
blocks.explanation:
Sine ka angle \(\frac{\pi}{6}\) khiska hua hai, phir 2 se multiply aur 1 jama.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: range likh kar 2 se multiply (positive hai, nishan wohi), phir 1 jama.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = 1 + 2\sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: \(-1 \le \sin(x + \frac{\pi}{6}) \le 1\); 2 se multiply (amplitude 2), phir 1 jama (wave 1 upar khisak gayi).

Sine ki range se shuru karein
\[-1 \le \sin\left(x + \tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) \le 1\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ka sine hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, chahe angle \(x\) ho, \(3x\) ho ya \(5x + \pi\). Andar ka number (jaise 3) sirf yeh badalta hai ke wave kitni jaldi repeat hogi (period), wave ki unchai nahi badalti. Yahi poore sawal ki bunyaad hai.

2 se multiply karein
\[-2 \le 2\sin\left(x + \tfrac{\pi}{6}\right) \le 2\]
Kyun: 2 positive number hai, is liye nishan nahi badalte; sirf range dugni ho jati hai: \(-2\) se 2 tak. Yahi 2 is function ka amplitude hai.

Har hisse mein 1 jama karein
\[-1 \le 1 + 2\sin\left(x + \tfrac{\pi}{6}\right)\]
\[\le 3\]
Kyun: \(-2 + 1 = -1\) aur \(2 + 1 = 3\). Lambi inequality ko do lines mein toda hai taake phone par aaram se parhi ja sake.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum 3 jab \(x + \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{\pi}{3}\).
Minimum \(-1\) jab \(x + \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{3\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{6} = \frac{4\pi}{3}\).
Kyun: Sine ka maximum \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) par aur minimum \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) par hota hai; poore angle ko in ke barabar rakh kar \(x\) nikala.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{3}: \; 1 + 2\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 3\]
\[x = \tfrac{4\pi}{3}: \; 1 + 2\sin\tfrac{3\pi}{2} = -1\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vii) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(\frac{1}{10 - 2\sin 3x}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh reciprocal wala function hai: \(y = \frac{1}{D}\), jahan \(D = 10 - 2\sin 3x\).
Humein \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: pehle denominator \(D\) ki range nikalein, phir use ulta (reciprocal) karein. Yaad rakhein: neeche wala number jitna chhota, fraction utna bara.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \frac{1}{10 - 2\sin 3x}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: Pehle denominator ki range \(-1 \le \sin 3x \le 1\) se nikalenge. Denominator hamesha positive rahega, is liye reciprocal lene par inequality ulat jayegi: sab se chhota denominator sab se bari value deta hai, aur sab se bara denominator sab se chhoti.

Sine ki range
\[-1 \le \sin 3x \le 1\]
Kyun: Kisi bhi angle ka sine hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, chahe angle \(x\) ho, \(3x\) ho ya \(5x + \pi\). Andar ka number (jaise 3) sirf yeh badalta hai ke wave kitni jaldi repeat hogi (period), wave ki unchai nahi badalti. Yahi poore sawal ki bunyaad hai.

Denominator banayein
\[2 \ge -2\sin 3x \ge -2\]
\[12 \ge 10 - 2\sin 3x \ge 8\]
Kyun: Pehle \(-2\) se multiply kiya (negative, is liye nishan ulte), phir 10 jama kiya. Nateeja: \(8 \le D \le 12\). Sab se ahem baat: \(D\) kabhi zero ya negative nahi hota, warna fraction ka matlab hi khatam ho jata.

Reciprocal lein
\[\tfrac{1}{12} \le \tfrac{1}{10 - 2\sin 3x} \le \tfrac{1}{8}\]
Kyun: Agar do positive numbers hon to jo bara hai us ka reciprocal (ulta, yani 1 upar) chhota hota hai: \(8 < 12\) magar \(\frac{1}{8} > \frac{1}{12}\). Yeh tabhi sahi hai jab dono positive hon, is liye pehle dekh liya ke denominator kabhi zero ya negative nahi hota.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum \(\frac{1}{8}\) jab \(D = 8\), yani \(\sin 3x = 1\), maslan \(3x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(x = \frac{\pi}{6}\).
Minimum \(\frac{1}{12}\) jab \(D = 12\), yani \(\sin 3x = -1\), maslan \(3x = \frac{3\pi}{2}\), \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: Aam ghalti: maximum ko \(\frac{1}{12}\) likh dena kyunke 12 bara hai. Fraction mein bara denominator chhoti value deta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{6}: \; \tfrac{1}{10 - 2(1)} = \tfrac{1}{8}\]
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{2}: \; \tfrac{1}{10 - 2(-1)} = \tfrac{1}{12}\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (viii) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(\frac{1}{7 + 3\cos(-2x)}\)
blocks.explanation:
Reciprocal function hai, aur denominator mein \(\cos(-2x)\) hai.
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: pehle negative angle ko seedha karein (cosine even function hai), phir denominator ki range nikal kar use ulta karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \frac{1}{7 + 3\cos(-2x)}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: Pehle denominator ki range \(-1 \le \cos 2x \le 1\) se nikalenge. Denominator hamesha positive rahega, is liye reciprocal lene par inequality ulat jayegi: sab se chhota denominator sab se bari value deta hai, aur sab se bara denominator sab se chhoti.

Negative angle hatayein
\[\cos(-2x) = \cos 2x\]
Kyun: Cosine even function hai: \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\) (Section 11.2). Unit circle par \(-\theta\) ka point \(\theta\) ke point ke bilkul neeche hota hai, dono ka x-coordinate ek hi, is liye cosine ek hi.

Denominator ki range
\[-1 \le \cos 2x \le 1\]
\[-3 \le 3\cos 2x \le 3\]
\[4 \le 7 + 3\cos 2x \le 10\]
Kyun: 3 se multiply kiya (positive, nishan wohi rahe), phir 7 jama kiya. Denominator 4 se 10 tak rehta hai, yani hamesha positive; fraction kabhi undefined nahi hota.

Reciprocal lein
\[\tfrac{1}{10} \le \tfrac{1}{7 + 3\cos(-2x)} \le \tfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: Agar do positive numbers hon to jo bara hai us ka reciprocal (ulta, yani 1 upar) chhota hota hai: \(8 < 12\) magar \(\frac{1}{8} > \frac{1}{12}\). Yeh tabhi sahi hai jab dono positive hon, is liye pehle dekh liya ke denominator kabhi zero ya negative nahi hota.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum \(\frac{1}{4}\) jab denominator 4 ho, yani \(\cos 2x = -1\), maslan \(2x = \pi\), \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Minimum \(\frac{1}{10}\) jab denominator 10 ho, yani \(\cos 2x = 1\), maslan \(x = 0\).

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{2}: \; \tfrac{1}{7 + 3\cos(-\pi)} = \tfrac{1}{4}\]
\[x = 0: \; \tfrac{1}{7 + 3\cos 0} = \tfrac{1}{10}\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ix) Find the maximum and minimum values of the following functions: \(\frac{1}{5 - 3\cos(3x - 1)}\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir se reciprocal; angle \(3x - 1\) hai (yeh radians mein hai, 1 matlab 1 radian).
Humein sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value chahiye.
Plan: denominator \(5 - 3\cos(3x - 1)\) ki range nikalein, phir reciprocal le kar ulta karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \frac{1}{5 - 3\cos(3x - 1)}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(y\) ki sab se bari aur sab se chhoti value.
Tareeqa: Pehle denominator ki range \(-1 \le \cos(3x - 1) \le 1\) se nikalenge. Denominator hamesha positive rahega, is liye reciprocal lene par inequality ulat jayegi: sab se chhota denominator sab se bari value deta hai, aur sab se bara denominator sab se chhoti.

Cosine ki range
\[-1 \le \cos(3x - 1) \le 1\]
Kyun: Cosine bhi sine ki tarah hamesha \(-1\) aur \(1\) ke darmiyan rehta hai, angle chahe kuch bhi ho. Andar wala angle sirf graph ko aage peeche ya tez/aahista karta hai; upar neeche ki had wohi \(-1\) aur \(1\) rehti hai.

Denominator banayein
\[3 \ge -3\cos(3x - 1) \ge -3\]
\[8 \ge 5 - 3\cos(3x - 1) \ge 2\]
Kyun: \(-3\) se multiply kiya to nishan ulte ho gaye, phir 5 jama kiya. Denominator 2 se 8 tak rehta hai, hamesha positive.

Reciprocal lein
\[\tfrac{1}{8} \le \tfrac{1}{5 - 3\cos(3x - 1)} \le \tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: Agar do positive numbers hon to jo bara hai us ka reciprocal (ulta, yani 1 upar) chhota hota hai: \(8 < 12\) magar \(\frac{1}{8} > \frac{1}{12}\). Yeh tabhi sahi hai jab dono positive hon, is liye pehle dekh liya ke denominator kabhi zero ya negative nahi hota.

Yeh values kahan milti hain
Maximum \(\frac{1}{2}\) jab denominator 2 ho, yani \(\cos(3x - 1) = 1\), maslan \(3x - 1 = 0\), \(x = \frac{1}{3}\).
Minimum \(\frac{1}{8}\) jab denominator 8 ho, yani \(\cos(3x - 1) = -1\), maslan \(3x - 1 = \pi\), \(x = \frac{1 + \pi}{3}\).
Kyun: Is denominator mein cosine ke saath minus hai, is liye cosine 1 ho to denominator sab se chhota (2) aur fraction sab se bari.

Tasdeeq
\[x = \tfrac{1}{3}: \; \tfrac{1}{5 - 3\cos 0} = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[x = \tfrac{1 + \pi}{3}: \; \tfrac{1}{5 - 3\cos\pi} = \tfrac{1}{8}\]
Kyun: Jo angles humne chune unhein function mein wapas rakha to bilkul wohi maximum aur minimum aaye. Is se pakka ho gaya ke yeh values sirf kaghaz par nahi, waqai function inhein chhoo leta hai.
